fit_reason: Whole 14 ft aluminum fishing boat with motor and trailer, sold by a private owner.
findings: Light-colored specks and debris scattered across the red floor carpet
Scuffs and grime on the white painted interior walls and bench fronts, especially near the stern area
Weathered, gray wood on the rear bench seat top and wooden seat legs
Dull, slightly hazy maroon paint on the exterior hull sides with some scuffing near the stern
Dull, oxidized-looking bare aluminum along the lower hull and transom
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 14 ft Lund. It looks well kept, and a pre-sale detail could make it pop in photos, mainly vacuuming the specks out of the red carpet and cleaning the scuffs off the white interior walls. We could also buff and wax the maroon hull sides to bring back some shine, and we come to you. Would you like a quote?
